description: This PHP script manages the addition of test case scripts in the TestLink project, including initializing environment, handling user actions for repository browsing, and writing script links to the database.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template rendering class used for displaying the page.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Manages test project data, used to retrieve project info.

classes.name: tlCodeTracker
classes.description: Handles code tracker interface and configuration.

classes.name: tlInputParameter
classes.description: Defines input parameter types and validation.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Manages test case data and custom fields.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Represents the current user and manages permissions.

methods.name: initEnv
methods.description: Initializes environment variables and request parameters.

methods.name: getCodeTracker
methods.description: Retrieves code tracker configuration and interface object.

methods.name: write_testcase_script
methods.description: Associates a test case version with a code script in the database.

methods.name: write_cfield_testscript
methods.description: Updates the custom field 'Test Script' for a test case if permitted.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has rights to modify test cases.
